scope: Continuous serial search over four actor-layer interpolation coefficients; no automatic deployment
proposal_rule: Coordinate changes +/-0.05 clipped to [0,1]; halve step after non-improving sweeps. Below step0.003125, use deterministic Gaussian multi-layer proposals (std0.02, seed20261019) around incumbent.
screening: Evaluate incumbent failures first, then all remaining cases. Reject immediately on a fall or once failure count cannot beat incumbent; preserve full declared plan and mark incomplete screening. Stop for setup/protocol failures.
acceptance: Only a complete no-fall run with strictly fewer failures becomes incumbent. No tie-based replacement.
validation: When cumulative failures reach zero, predeclare six unused 20ms-aligned durations sampled from [1.1,4.0], with both signs, loads and delays. All48 must pass; otherwise retain them in cumulative suite. Validation falls require review.
termination: Stop on complete native-suite plus fresh-validation pass, explicit interruption, setup error, or less than10GiB free disk. Runs and rejected candidates are never overwritten. A native-suite pass is not physical/ROS mission qualification.
